name: Sakinalu
instructions: 1. Soak and grind new rice into a fine, slightly damp flour. 2. Mix with vamu, sesame seeds, and salt. 3. Form a stiff dough. 4. Shape into concentric circles on a clean cloth. 5. Deep fry until golden and extremely crunchy.
description: The intricate, hand-shaped spirals of Telangana, a crunchy tribute to tradition.
